output.reason: Evidence states: (i) for floating rate loans sanctioned or renewed on/after 1 Jan 2026 (for purposes other than business to individuals), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges; and (ii) for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before 31 Dec 2025 (for purposes other than business to individual borrowers), a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges. The claim’s date-based conclusion (“sanctioned in March 2026 ⇒ later rule applies, not the earlier rule”) follows if the loan fits the evidence’s scope (i.e., it is a floating rate loan and the stated purpose condition). However, the evidence provided does not confirm those scope facts for the specific loan, only the cutoff dates. Therefore the claim is only partially supported.
